controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from a measured spectrum of the star (VLT/X-shooter). The disc is unresolved, and no darkening toward the edge is measured.
controls.notes: The colour of Proxima Centauri's VLT/X-shooter spectrum. ESO's Very Large Telescope observed it on 15 January 2014; Proxima flares, so this is one moment. No resolved image of the surface is cast here.
